descriptions.notStarted: I have this seed that Swallow gave me. Should I give this to Hongbu?
descriptions.inProgress: I took this seed that Swallow gave me and gave it to Hongbu. When notified that the seed was indeed from Swallow, Hongbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside.
descriptions.completed: I gave Hongbu the seed that Swallow gave me. Hongbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside. When the gourd grew and was big enough to open, it contained a chest full of treasures.
